question: Should this PR be rebuilt as the canonical QA-only fix, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102079 be used instead?
rationale: The QA code shape is correct, but the current head carries broad unrelated changes and a protected maintainer label, so branch selection and cleanup need maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Rebuild this PR as QA-only
